rules.text: Infectious Genjutsu: a failed save or hit makes it a relay until the start of your next turn: once per turn an ally of it moving within 10 feet saves against the Genjutsu as the original target.

castOption.label: Onijutsu: Infectious Genjutsu (1 Oni-Coil)
castOption.note: a failed save or hit makes it a relay until the start of your next turn: once per turn an ally of it moving within 10 feet saves against the Genjutsu as the original target.

system.description: When an affected creature, fails their saving throw or you score a hit with your Genjutsu attack, the target becomes a relay point for your Genjutsu. Until the beginning of your next turn, Once per turn, if the affected creature has an ally move within 10 feet of them, the moving creature must make a Saving throw against the effects of your Genjutsu, suffering its effects as if they were the original target.
